s0101.literal: Its inspector supervised Yuan Province, concurrently held the post of Administrator of Wuling, and administered Wuling commandery.
s0101.idiomatic: Its inspector oversaw Yuan Province, served concurrently as administrator of Wuling, and governed from Wuling commandery.

s0102.literal: The six counties under its commandant's jurisdiction constituted Yuan Province.
s0102.idiomatic: The six counties under the commandant's authority were organized as Yuan Province.

s0103.literal: Tongning commandery was separately established; the inspector concurrently held the administrator's post, administering from the commandant's walled city, and the former commandant post was abolished.
s0103.idiomatic: Tongning commandery was set up separately; the inspector also served as its administrator, with his seat at the commandant's fortress, and the old commandant office was abolished.

s0104.literal: Wu Mingche, General Who Pacifies the South, Inspector of South Yanzhou, and newly appointed Right Palace Guard General, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Wu Prefecture; Sun Rang, the pretender Xiao Zhuang's Inspector of Yingzhou, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou.
s0104.idiomatic: Wu Mingche, general who pacifies the south, inspector of South Yanzhou, and newly appointed right palace guard general, was made general who pacifies the west and inspector of Wu prefecture; Sun Rang, whom the pretender Xiao Zhuang had named inspector of Yingzhou, was made general who pacifies the south and inspector of Xiangzhou.

s0105.literal: On jingzi day the Prince of Hengyang, Chang, died.
s0105.idiomatic: On jingzi day the Prince of Hengyang, Chang, died.

s0106.literal: On dingchou day an edict said: "As for civil and military officials whom Xiao Zhuang had falsely appointed who return to court, each is to be enrolled and ranked according to merit."
s0106.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict declared: "Civil and military officers who served in Xiao Zhuang's false regime and now return to court are to be registered and promoted according to their merits."

s0107.literal: In the fourth month, on dinghai day, the imperial son Boxin was enfeoffed as Prince of Hengyang to continue the line of the late prince.
s0107.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dinghai day, the imperial son Boxin was enfeoffed as Prince of Hengyang to continue the line of the late prince.

s0108.literal: On yiwei day Xun Lang, General Who Pacifies the South, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of He Province.
s0108.idiomatic: On yiwei day Xun Lang, general who pacifies the south, was made general who pacifies the north and inspector of He province.

s0109.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao day, Rucheng county in Guiyang was made Luyang commandery.
s0109.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao day, Rucheng county in Guiyang was elevated to Luyang commandery.

s0110.literal: The two commanderies of Shixing and Anyuan in Hengzhou were split off to establish East Hengzhou.
s0110.idiomatic: The commanderies of Shixing and Anyuan in Hengzhou were detached to form East Hengzhou.

s0111.literal: In the sixth month, on xinsi day, the posthumous title of the Founder's grandmother, Empress Jing'an, was changed to Empress Jingwen.
s0111.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinsi day, the posthumous title of the Founder's grandmother, Empress Jing'an, was changed to Empress Jingwen.

s0112.literal: On renchen day an edict said: "Emperor Xiaoyuan of Liang suffered many calamities; his coffin was carried far abroad. We once faced north toward him in a bond outside the usual order and sent envoys to meet him by the nearest route.
s0112.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict declared: "Emperor Xiaoyuan of Liang endured grievous trials, and his coffin was borne far from home. We once faced north toward him in a bond beyond ordinary measure and sent envoys to receive him by the shortest route.

s0113.literal: Since Jiangning is the old burial ground, [8] it is fitting to fix the tomb site at once; carriage banners and ritual regalia shall all follow Liang precedent, after the story of Wei burying Emperor Xian of Han."
s0113.idiomatic: Since Jiangning is the ancestral burial ground, [8] the tomb should be fixed there at once; carriage banners and ritual regalia shall follow Liang precedent, on the model of Wei burying Emperor Xian of Han."

s0114.literal: On jiawu day the late consort of Zhaolie, Prince of Shixing, the Founder's mother, was posthumously invested as Imperial Consort Xiao.
s0114.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Founder's mother, the late consort of Zhaolie, Prince of Shixing, was posthumously honored as Imperial Consort Xiao.

s0115.literal: On dingyou day Xu Du, Champion of the State with Honours Equal to the Three Dukes, was made Palace Attendant and Central Army General.
s0115.idiomatic: On dingyou day Xu Du, champion of the state with honours equal to the three dukes, was made palace attendant and central army general.

s0116.literal: On xinchou day, when the year's mourning observance for the state lapsed, the Emperor went in person to the front hall of the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate; the hundred officials accompanied him in weeping.
s0116.idiomatic: On xinchou day, when the year's mourning for the state was complete, the emperor went in person to the front hall of the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate, and the hundred officials joined him in mourning.

s0117.literal: Amnesty within the capital for capital offenses and below.
s0117.idiomatic: An amnesty was proclaimed in the capital for capital crimes and below.

s0118.literal: That month Emperor Yuan of Liang was buried at Jiangning.
s0118.idiomatic: That month Emperor Yuan of Liang was buried at Jiangning.

s0119.literal: In the seventh month, on jiayin day, an edict said: "We, with Our slight person, have received the great treasure; the burden borne is utmost and anxiety and responsibility truly deep—yet the myriad tasks are not at peace and mutual resentment still knots. We look to worthy men as in a dream; whenever one word enters Our hearing or a scrap of goodness can be sought, how have We ever failed to praise, draw forth, and bind to Our girdle?
s0119.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiayin day, an edict declared: "We, unworthy as We are, have received the great mandate; the burden is heavy and Our anxiety deep—yet the realm is not at peace and grievances still fester. We long for the worthy as in a dream; whenever a word of counsel reaches Us or the least merit appears, how have We failed to praise it, draw it forth, and bind it to Our sash?

s0120.literal: Yet the rock of Fuyue stands empty and deep valleys still lie submerged; rush silks are offered in vain and the signal bow does not come.
s0120.idiomatic: Yet the rock of Fuyue stands empty and deep valleys remain unvisited; offerings of rush are laid out in vain and the signal bow is never bent.

s0121.literal: Is it that We fall short of the wise who choose men, and that talent in the grass and marshes is lost?
s0121.idiomatic: Is it that We fall short of the sage who chooses men, and that talent in the wilds is lost?

s0122.literal: Or that the times run muddy and the present cannot match antiquity?
s0122.idiomatic: Or that the age runs foul and the present cannot equal antiquity?

s0123.literal: We eat on one side and ever cherish the thought; rising and lying down We only sigh the more.
s0123.idiomatic: We take Our meals on one side and brood without cease; waking and sleeping We sigh all the more.

s0124.literal: Lu Shan Talent, Administrator of Xin'an, submitted a memorial recommending Xiao Ce, former aide-de-camp on the western campaign of Liang, and Wang Xun, former director of centre in the Ministry of War of Liang—both of pure lineage from noble houses, standards of their clans; one sufficient in letters and histories, the other in filial virtue fit for praise—each is to be raised in court order and promoted out of turn.
s0124.idiomatic: Lu Shan Talent, administrator of Xin'an, memorialized recommending Xiao Ce, former aide on Liang's western campaign staff, and Wang Xun, former director in the Ministry of War of Liang—both of eminent lineage and shining houses; one adequate in letters and histories, the other in filial virtue worthy of praise—and asked that each be raised in court rank and promoted out of turn.

s0125.literal: From kings and dukes down, each is to advance recommendations of worthy men and report those wronged and submerged, so that the multitude of talents may surely gather, the great hall may be raised, and the poems of Zhi Pu and You Geng may again be sung." [9]
s0125.idiomatic: From kings and dukes downward, each is to recommend worthy men and report those wronged and overlooked, so that talents may gather, the great hall be built, and the songs of Zhi Pu and You Geng be sung once more." [9]

s0126.literal: On yimao day an edict said: "Since the recent disorders households have scattered; thinking of the remaining people, We are truly moved to pity.
s0126.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict declared: "Since the recent disorders households have been uprooted; thinking of the people who remain, We are deeply moved to pity.

s0127.literal: Those who have lost their native districts and land and drift seeking food—in this year let them settle where they find comfort; next year, without distinguishing native from refugee, all are to be registered on the rolls, following the precedent of unified territorial registration."
s0127.idiomatic: Those who have lost their native places and wander seeking livelihood may this year settle where they find ease; next year, without distinguishing old residents from newcomers, all shall be entered on the registers, following the precedent of unified territorial registration."

s0128.literal: On jingchen day the imperial son Boshan was enfeoffed as Prince of Poyang.
s0128.idiomatic: On jingchen day the imperial son Boshan was enfeoffed as Prince of Poyang.

s0129.literal: In the eighth month, on gengchen day, the Old Man star appeared.
s0129.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen day, the Old Man star appeared.

s0130.literal: On renwu day an edict said: "The worth of beans and millet is heavier than pearls and jade.
s0130.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict declared: "The worth of grain is greater than pearls and jade.

s0131.literal: Since the recent campaigns idlers have been many; the people have lost the industry of allotted fields, and gentlemen bear the mockery of wearing oxen at their belts.
s0131.idiomatic: Since the recent wars idlers have multiplied; the people have lost their allotted fields, and gentlemen are mocked for wearing oxen at their belts.

s0132.literal: We pity the black-haired people and wish to heal a ruined custom, thinking to rescue those blocked by hunger and yet to enrich through teaching.
s0132.idiomatic: We pity the common people and wish to heal a ruined way of life, seeking to relieve hunger and yet to enrich them through instruction.

s0133.literal: The use of wheat is urgently needful—now the ninth month is at hand and the myriad harvests can be gathered; proclaim this far and near and all are to sow.
s0133.idiomatic: Wheat is urgently needed—now the ninth month is at hand and the myriad crops can be gathered; proclaim this far and near and order all to sow.

s0134.literal: Governors and prefects are to come in person to urge the season's work and see that it is done in time.
s0134.idiomatic: Governors and prefects are to go in person to urge the season's work and see that it is done in time.

s0135.literal: Where there is extreme poverty, distribute seed according to measure."
s0135.idiomatic: Where households are utterly destitute, seed is to be distributed according to need."

s0136.literal: On guiwei day the Founding Emperor held court at Jingyang Hall to hear lawsuits.
s0136.idiomatic: On guiwei day Emperor Wen heard cases in person at Jingyang Hall.

s0137.literal: On wuzi day an edict said: "The muddy goblet and earthen drum—sincerity is hard to recover; painted eggs and carved kindling—or perhaps they can be changed.
s0137.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict declared: "The muddy goblet and earthen drum—such sincerity is hard to recover; painted eggs and carved firewood—or perhaps they can be changed.

s0138.literal: In Liang's last fortune luxury had grown extreme; meat feasts sated petty clerks, singing bells lined the storehouses, earth and timber bore cinnabar hues, carriages and horses were adorned with gold and jade treasures—following desire the stream ran ever more polluted and error drifted far.
s0138.idiomatic: In Liang's last days luxury had grown extreme: meat feasts sated petty clerks, singing bells filled the storehouses, buildings were painted cinnabar, carriages and horses were adorned with gold and jade—desire ran like a muddy stream and error drifted ever farther.

s0139.literal: We, from student years, have found inward sufficiency, yet the family has cultivated plainness and the chambers have been free of ostentation; viewing the fashion of the times We have often wrung Our hands.
s0139.idiomatic: We, from Our student years, have been inwardly content, yet Our house has cultivated plainness and Our chambers have been free of display; viewing the fashion of the age We have often wrung Our hands.

s0140.literal: Now, falsely riding the timely chance and facing the utmost pole of the realm, as We stand in a fallen age We wish to hear the way of good order; plain food and low palace, resting content in thrift and simplicity, to make this shallow custom recover pure wind.
s0140.idiomatic: Now, having falsely seized the timely moment and come to face the realm's summit, as We stand in a fallen age We wish to hear the way of good order: plain food and humble palace, content in thrift and simplicity, that this shallow custom may return to pure wind.

s0141.literal: Carved decoration and licentious ornament—not those arms or utensils the state rites require—gold, silver, pearls, jade, garments and assorted playthings: all alike are forbidden."
s0141.idiomatic: Carved ornament and licentious display—not arms or utensils required for state ritual—gold, silver, pearls, jade, garments, and assorted luxuries: all alike are forbidden."

s0142.literal: On jiawu day Zhou General He Ruodun led ten thousand horse and foot, suddenly reaching Wuling; Wu Prefecture Inspector Wu Mingche could not resist and led the army back to Baling.
s0142.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Zhou general He Ruodun led ten thousand horse and foot and suddenly reached Wuling; Wu Mingche, inspector of Wu prefecture, could not hold him and withdrew to Baling.

s0143.literal: On dingyou day the Emperor visited Zhengyang Hall to review arms.
s0143.idiomatic: On dingyou day the emperor reviewed troops at Zhengyang Hall.

s0144.literal: In the ninth month, on guichou day, a comet appeared.
s0144.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guichou day, a comet appeared.

s0145.literal: On yimao day Zhou General Dugu Sheng led the navy intending Ba and Xiang; with He Ruodun advancing by water and land together, Grand Marshal Hou Tian went from Xunyang to check them.
s0145.idiomatic: On yimao day the Zhou general Dugu Sheng led the fleet toward Ba and Xiang; with He Ruodun advancing by land and water together, Grand Marshal Hou Tian marched from Xunyang to oppose them.

s0146.literal: On xinyou day Commissioner-with-Equal-Rank Xu Du was sent leading troops to join Tian at Baqiu.
s0146.idiomatic: On xinyou day Xu Du, commissioner with equal rank, was dispatched with troops to join Hou Tian at Baqiu.

s0147.literal: On jingzi day the Great White star appeared in daylight.
s0147.idiomatic: On jingzi day the planet Venus was seen in daylight.

s0148.literal: On dingchou day an edict ordered Tian and the host of armies to advance and attack Ba and Xiang.
s0148.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered Hou Tian and the host of armies to advance against Ba and Xiang.

s0149.literal: In the tenth month, on guisi day, Hou Tian ambushed and broke Dugu Sheng at Yangye islet, capturing all his vessels; Sheng gathered troops ashore and built a walled camp to hold himself.
s0149.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guisi day, Hou Tian ambushed and routed Dugu Sheng at Yangye Islet, seizing all his ships; Sheng gathered his men ashore and built a fortified camp to hold his ground.

s0150.literal: On dingyou day an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Andu to lead troops to join Tian in the southern campaign.
s0150.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict ordered Hou Andu, minister of works, to lead troops south to join Hou Tian.

s0151.literal: In the twelfth month, on yiwei day, an edict said: "In antiquity spring and summer, the two seasons, did not decide capital crimes.
s0151.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiwei day, an edict declared: "In antiquity the two seasons of spring and summer did not decide capital crimes.

s0152.literal: For yang harmony spreads bounty and Heaven's order is thus broad; a lenient net and wary punishment [10] match fostering nurture—the former kings thereby modeled Heaven and earth and legislated to hand down teaching.
s0152.idiomatic: For when yang harmony spreads its bounty Heaven's order is broad; a lenient net and cautious punishment [10] accord with fostering life—the former kings thereby took Heaven and earth as their model and set laws to hand down teaching.

s0153.literal: We stand in a fallen age and seek the people's woes; pity and compassion are deep, and Our thought of those drowning is like filling a moat—we ever wish to follow the old tracks to lengthen custom's wind.
s0153.idiomatic: We stand in a fallen age and seek the people's afflictions; Our pity is deep, and Our thought of those drowning is like filling a moat—we ever wish to follow the old tracks and lengthen the wind of custom.

s0154.literal: From now, from the first month of spring until the start of summer, in cases of capital crime already confessed, execution is for the present to be suspended."
s0154.idiomatic: From now, from the first month of spring until the start of summer, in capital cases where guilt is already established, execution is for the present to be suspended."

s0155.literal: On jihai day Yuchi Xian, Zhou governor of Baling city, surrendered; Baling Inspector Hou Anding was sent to hold it.
s0155.idiomatic: On jihai day Yuchi Xian, Zhou commander of Baling, surrendered; Hou Anding, inspector of Baling, was sent to hold the city.

s0156.literal: [11] On gengzi day Dugu Sheng with his remaining troops secretly fled from Yangye islet.
s0156.idiomatic: [11] On gengzi day Dugu Sheng fled secretly from Yangye Islet with his remaining troops.

s0157.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on gengxu day, a general amnesty throughout the realm.
s0157.idiomatic: In the second year, spring, first month, on gengxu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0158.literal: Du Ling, General of Cloudy Pennons and Administrator of Jinling, was made Palace Attendant and Director of the Guard.
s0158.idiomatic: Du Ling, general of cloudy pennons and administrator of Jinling, was made palace attendant and director of the guard.

s0159.literal: On xinhai day the Prince of Shixing, Bomao, was made General Who Spreads Favour and Yangzhou Inspector.
s0159.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Prince of Shixing, Bomao, was made general who spreads favour and inspector of Yangzhou.

s0160.literal: On yimao day He Province Inspector Pei Jinghui defected to Qi.
s0160.idiomatic: On yimao day Pei Jinghui, inspector of He province, defected to Qi.

s0161.literal: [12] On xinwei day Yin Liang, Zhou governor of Xiangzhou city, surrendered; Xiangzhou was pacified.
s0161.idiomatic: [12] On xinwei day Yin Liang, Zhou commander of Xiangzhou, surrendered, and Xiangzhou was pacified.

s0162.literal: In the second month, on jingxu day, Grand Marshal Hou Tian was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Xiangzhou Inspector.
s0162.idiomatic: In the second month, on jingxu day, Grand Marshal Hou Tian was made grand general of chariots and cavalry and inspector of Xiangzhou.

s0163.literal: On gengyin day a partial amnesty for the commanderies of Xiangzhou.
s0163.idiomatic: On gengyin day a partial amnesty was granted for the commanderies of Xiangzhou.

s0164.literal: In the third month, on yimao day, Grand Marshal, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Xiangzhou Inspector Hou Tian died.
s0164.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao day, Hou Tian, grand marshal, grand general of chariots and cavalry, and inspector of Xiangzhou, died.

s0165.literal: On dingchou day [13] Xu Du, General Who Pacifies the East and Administrator of Kuaiji, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Xiangzhou Inspector.
s0165.idiomatic: On dingchou day [13] Xu Du, general who pacifies the east and administrator of Kuaiji, was made general who pacifies the south and inspector of Xiangzhou.

s0166.literal: In the fourth month of summer, the four commanderies of Nanping, Yidu, Luo, and Hedong in Jingzhou were split off to establish South Jingzhou, administered from Hedong commandery.
s0166.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, the four commanderies of Nanping, Yidu, Luo, and Hedong in Jingzhou were detached to form South Jingzhou, with its seat at Hedong commandery.

s0167.literal: Wu Mingche, General Who Pacifies the West and Wu Prefecture Inspector, was made South Jingzhou Inspector.
s0167.idiomatic: Wu Mingche, general who pacifies the west and inspector of Wu prefecture, was made inspector of South Jingzhou.

s0168.literal: On gengyin day Lu Sidao, General Who Pacifies the Left, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Wu Prefecture Inspector.
s0168.idiomatic: On gengyin day Lu Sidao, general who pacifies the left, was made general who pacifies the south and inspector of Wu prefecture.

s0169.literal: On xinmao day the Old Man star appeared.
s0169.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Old Man star appeared.

s0170.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jingwu day, Zhou General He Ruodun broke out and fled on his own; men and livestock dead were seven or eight in ten.
s0170.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jingwu day, the Zhou general He Ruodun broke out and fled on his own; seven or eight in ten of his men and livestock perished.

s0171.literal: Wuling, Tianmen, Nanping, Yiyang, Hedong, and Yidu commanderies were all pacified.
s0171.idiomatic: The commanderies of Wuling, Tianmen, Nanping, Yiyang, Hedong, and Yidu were all pacified.

s0172.literal: In the ninth month, on jiayin day, an edict said: "When the House of Ji was opening its work, hopes fixed on the Wei bank; when Han's sequence fused, the Way reached the ruined altar.
s0172.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiayin day, an edict declared: "When the house of Ji was opening its work, hopes fixed on the banks of the Wei; when Han's mandate was fulfilled, the Way reached the ruined altar.

s0173.literal: If one gathers essence from the constellations and sends down spirit from the sacred peak, when wind and cloud respond and dreams seek their man—this is indeed the boat and oar, the salt and plum, inward and outward in turn, for long ages founding states—has it ever been otherwise?
s0173.idiomatic: When essence is gathered from the constellations and spirit descends from the sacred peak, when wind and cloud respond and dreams seek their man—this is indeed the boat and oar, the salt and plum, inner and outer in turn, for founding states through long ages—has it ever been otherwise?

s0174.literal: And when merit is inscribed in the Grand Steward and they follow sacrifice in the clear temple, to leave it to those who come after and hang it in imperishable record.
s0174.idiomatic: And when merit is inscribed in the Grand Steward and they share sacrifice in the clear temple, to leave it to those who come after and hang it in imperishable record.

s0175.literal: The former emperor regulated the realm and completed the shaping of things; numinous favour was bestowed and the treasured mandate brightly received—though sagely brilliance burst forth and hidden and manifest alike followed, still civil and military worthies aided and spread the royal enterprise.
s0175.idiomatic: The former emperor regulated the realm and completed the shaping of things; numinous favour was bestowed and the treasured mandate brightly received—though sagely brilliance shone forth and hidden and manifest alike followed, still civil and military worthies aided and spread the royal enterprise.

s0176.literal: Thus Grand Marshal and General-in-Chief Tian, thus Minister of Works Wenyu, thus General Who Pacifies the North and Champion with Honours Sengming, thus Central Army Commander Ying, thus Director of the Guard Ni—or framed structure in hardship and steered policy through peril;
s0176.idiomatic: Thus the late Grand Marshal and general-in-chief Hou Tian, the late Minister of Works Zhou Wenyu, the late general who pacifies the north and champion with honours Zhou Sengming, the late central army commander Hu Ying, and the late director of the guard Chen Ni—some framed the structure in hardship and steered policy through peril;

s0177.literal: some dashed the vanguard and braved the blade, dying for righteousness and leaving their lives;
s0177.idiomatic: some dashed the vanguard and braved the blade, dying for righteousness and leaving their lives;

s0178.literal: some with bright wisdom joined counsel and bound the inner strategy;
s0178.idiomatic: some with bright wisdom joined counsel and bound the inner strategy;

s0179.literal: some cleared thorns and sweated for the horse, diligent from first to last;
s0179.idiomatic: some cleared thorns and sweated for the horse, diligent from first to last;

s0180.literal: none failed to exhaust loyalty and strength, and by them security was established.
s0180.idiomatic: none failed to exhaust loyalty and strength, and by them security was established.

s0181.literal: We, dim and few, have succeeded to the great line; ever speaking of their achievements We wish to enlarge the canon: let the former substance be followed, the grand track be raised—they may all share sacrifice in the High Ancestor's temple court, that this great design may ever pass through the ancestral tablets."
s0181.idiomatic: We, dim and few, have succeeded to the great line; ever mindful of their achievements We wish to enlarge the canon: let the former precedent be followed and the grand track be raised—they may all share sacrifice in the High Ancestor's temple court, that this great design may ever pass through the ancestral tablets."

s0182.literal: On jingchen day Wang Chong, Palace Attendant, Central Authority General, Special Grandee, Left Grandee of the Imperial Household, and Champion with Honours, was made Intendant of Danyang;
s0182.idiomatic: On jingchen day Wang Chong, palace attendant, central authority general, special grandee, left grandee of the imperial household, and champion with honours, was made intendant of Danyang;

s0183.literal: Shen Junli, Intendant of Danyang, was made Director of the Left in the Ministry of the People and concurrently Commandant of Footsoldiers.
s0183.idiomatic: Shen Junli, intendant of Danyang, was made director of the left in the Ministry of the People and concurrently commandant of footsoldiers.

s0184.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yisi day, [14] the Western Mountain barbarians of Huo Prefecture led their tribes to submit.
s0184.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yisi day, [14] the Western Mountain tribes of Huo Prefecture led their clans to submit.

s0185.literal: In the eleventh month, on yimao day, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
s0185.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yimao day, Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

s0186.literal: On jiazi day Wuchang and Guochuan were made Jingling commandery to settle wandering people.
s0186.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wuchang and Guochuan were formed into Jingling commandery to settle displaced people.

s0187.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinsi day, Sun Rang, General Who Pacifies the East and Administrator of Wu commandery, was made Central Army Commander.
s0187.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinsi day, Sun Rang, general who pacifies the east and administrator of Wu commandery, was made central army commander.

s0188.literal: On jiashen day the temple of the state of Shixing was established in the capital, using the rites of a king.
s0188.idiomatic: On jiashen day the ancestral temple of the state of Shixing was established in the capital with the rites due a king.

s0189.literal: Crown Prince Attendant Yu Li and Imperial Censor-in-Chief Kong Huan, because state revenue was insufficient, memorialized to establish levies on boiling sea salt and monopolies on wine, and an edict ordered both measures carried out.
s0189.idiomatic: Yu Li, attendant to the crown prince, and Kong Huan, imperial censor-in-chief, because state revenue was insufficient, memorialized to establish levies on sea-salt boiling and wine monopolies; an edict ordered both measures carried out.

s0190.literal: Earlier, Shixin Inspector Liu Yi had responded to Wang Lin and others in rebellion; on jingxu day an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Andu to lead troops to attack him.
s0190.idiomatic: Earlier, Liu Yi, inspector of Shixin, had joined Wang Lin's rebellion; on jingxu day an edict ordered Hou Andu, minister of works, to lead troops against him.

s0191.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on gengxu day, a ritual canopy was set up at the Southern Suburb and silks were offered to Lord Hu to accompany Heaven.
s0191.idiomatic: In the third year, spring, first month, on gengxu day, a ritual canopy was set up at the Southern Suburb and silks were offered to Lord Hu as companion to Heaven.

s0192.literal: On xinhai day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
s0192.idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

s0193.literal: An edict said: "We bear the treasured chart, the stars turn again and again, diligent and fearful, We hope for order settled—yet virtue does not reach the people and custom's ills grow worse; ever speaking of it We cannot forget day or night.
s0193.idiomatic: An edict declared: "We bear the imperial chart; the stars turn again and again; diligent and fearful, We hope for settled order—yet Our virtue has not won the people and custom's ills grow worse; speaking of it We cannot forget it day or night.

s0194.literal: Yang harmony spreads its breath; the bright service is to the Supreme; We personally offer victims and jade, sincerity joined with reverent offering, thinking to make the black-haired people share this broad bounty.
s0194.idiomatic: When yang harmony spreads its breath We brightly serve the Supreme; We personally offer victims and jade in sincerity and reverent offering, thinking to share this broad bounty with the people.

s0195.literal: A general grant of noble rank of one degree to the people may be made.
s0195.idiomatic: A general grant of noble rank of one degree may be made to the people.

s0196.literal: Those filial, brotherly, and diligent in farming receive an additional degree.
s0196.idiomatic: Those noted for filial piety, brotherliness, and diligence in farming receive an additional degree.

s0197.literal: On xinyou day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Northern Suburb.
s0197.idiomatic: On xinyou day the emperor personally sacrificed at the Northern Suburb.

s0198.literal: In the intercalary second month, on jiyou day, Yu Ming, King of Baekje, was made Grand General Who Pacifies the East, and Gao Tang [15], King of Goguryeo, was made General Who Tranquilizes the East.
s0198.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month, on jiyou day, Yu Ming, king of Baekje, was made grand general who pacifies the east, and Gao Tang [15], king of Goguryeo, was made general who tranquilizes the east.

s0199.literal: Jiangzhou Inspector Zhou Di raised troops in response to Liu Yi, attacked Pencheng, and assaulted Yuzhang commandery, but did not overcome them.
s0199.idiomatic: Zhou Di, inspector of Jiangzhou, raised troops in support of Liu Yi, attacked Pencheng, and assaulted Yuzhang commandery, but could not take them.

s0200.literal: On xinhai day Wu Mingche, Inspector of South Jingzhou, was made General Who Pacifies the Right.
s0200.idiomatic: On xinhai day Wu Mingche, inspector of South Jingzhou, was made general who pacifies the right.
